command:
set -euo pipefail
source scripts/tex_environment.sh
python3 flatten_sources.py
cp single.tex single_build/book_single.tex
cp report_single.tex single_build/audit_single.tex
cd single_build
for f in book_single audit_single; do
 for pass in 1 2 3; do flags=(); if [[ "$pass" -lt 3 ]]; then flags=(-no-pdf); fi; xelatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error "${flags[@]}" "$f.tex" > "$f.pass$pass.log.txt" 2>&1 || exit $?; done
done
scope: Both independent standalone variants rebuilt after verified line-based input flattening fix. Modular book and report sources and PDFs unchanged.
